pass.answer: The N+1 query problem is what happens when code loads a list of rows with one query and then runs one more query per row to fetch a related record, so a page of 50 orders becomes 51 round trips to the database. ORMs make it easy to hit because lazy loading hides the extra queries behind ordinary attribute access.
